title: [ingest] Subconscious lists cap at 25 items
summary: The subconscious subsystem uses a shared cap of 25 for events, loop observations, session companion observations, anchor observations, anchor decisions, ideas, and proposal listings. That explains why some history and suggestion surfaces feel shallow by design rather than buggy.
